justification: The clean-host continuation requires preservation of every failed resource-smoke attempt, accepted cap result, and final frozen Base/Prior outcome.
Most added lines are raw host-memory sample series, atomic episode partials, and stdout/stderr logs, not source-code expansion.
The raw evidence is required to audit the 82 percent host ceiling, zero-swap and pagefile gates, exact identity completion, memory release, and absence of hidden failed runs.
The implementation surface is bounded to four launch/monitor scripts and two focused contract-test files; the frozen scientific runner remains byte-identical.
Only the clean-host A2C2 evidence roots and their reports are force-added from ignored runs directories.
explicit_exclusions: unrelated runs, checkpoints, caches, and user files
